laws.rule: Dresden charges an accommodation tax (Beherbergungssteuer) of 6% of the room price including VAT; breakfast, half board and minibar are excluded.
laws.heading: Beherbergungssteuersatzung Dresden

laws.rule: Leipzig charges an accommodation tax (Beherbergungssteuer) of 5% of the room price including VAT, per person per night; under-18s are among those exempt.
laws.heading: Satzung über die Erhebung einer Beherbergungssteuer in der Stadt Leipzig

local-law.note: Dresden and Leipzig only; other Saxon cities not yet checked.
